title: Blood carries nutrients, gases, and wastes through the body
summary: OpenStax says blood is a fluid tissue that carries nutrients, gases, and wastes, and also helps defend the body and keep its internal conditions in balance.
body: OpenStax says blood is a fluid connective tissue. Its jobs include transportation of nutrients, gases, and wastes, defense against infection and other threats, and homeostatic regulation of pH, temperature, and other internal conditions. Blood is formed elements plus plasma. More than 90 percent of plasma is water. This card is that transport-and-balance overview. Blood types are a different card.
